answer: Because the crystal solution is checked at the violet gate and logged, the zenith audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 26 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The fee repeats 19 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
